summary: The whole top area of the browser window: the tab strip, navigation toolbar, and bookmarks bar together.
description: The real XUL <toolbox> element, the container holding every browser toolbar. A built-in XUL widget tag with no JS class and no registered custom element: navigator-toolbox.inc.xhtml declares it carrying nothing but an id, and the 578 lines of navigator-toolbox.js are event delegation hung on #navigator-toolbox by id (popupshowing, command) rather than anything reading configuration off the element. Classified classic as a real XUL widget tag rather than none, but unlike <toolbar> it exposes no attributes worth documenting.
